# BCGov Crow - v0.8.3

## Release type

Patch release documenting a change-aware trigger for the approval-gated
release draft workflow.

## Summary

This release documents that the Crow release draft workflow now checks the
validated `main` commit before starting release preparation, and only
proceeds when the release-defining `apm.yml` file or a file under `.apm/`
actually changed, including packaged skill and agent documentation. Commits
limited to the top-level README, `crow.config`, or GitHub workflow files no
longer produce a release candidate or draft release.

## Highlights

- The `crow-release` skill guidance now describes the change-aware gate ahead
  of candidate preparation, so maintainers and Crow agents can rely on the
  documented contract when reasoning about whether a merge will start a
  release.
- README, package metadata, and archive names are updated to v0.8.3.

## Changes

- Clarified the Crow release skill's description of the approval-gated draft
  workflow to cover the release-relevant change check that precedes
  candidate preparation.
- Updated package metadata, README installation examples, and plugin metadata
  to version 0.8.3.

## Validation

- Crow asset validation: passed with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
- Package dry run: passed; 166 public package entries were inspected.
- Archive inspection: passed; no evidence, scanner state, or build output was
  present.
- Additional checks: Crow release guard tests and release-draft-preparation
  tests passed on the exact release commit.
- Sonar scan: completed for branch `agents/release-workflow-trigger-optimization`
  at the exact release commit; quality gate: OK, all conditions met.

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.8.3 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.8.3.zip --global --target copilot
```
